description: Manages personalized views and quick access to user-specific partners, contacts, and interactions, including drafts and recent organizational unit updates.

endpoints.name: GetMyPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of partners associated with the current user's dashboard, including those created or modified by the user, excluding drafts.
example_uses: Get the partners I'm working on.
Show me all partners I've recently updated.
List my active partners on the dashboard.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to quickly view partners relevant to the current user's activities, such as those they created or recently modified, excluding any draft partners.

endpoints.name: GetMyContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of contacts associated with the current user's dashboard, including those created or modified by the user, excluding drafts.
example_uses: Get the contacts I'm managing.
Show me all contacts I've recently interacted with.
List my active contacts on the dashboard.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to quickly view contacts relevant to the current user's activities, such as those they created or recently modified, excluding any draft contacts.

endpoints.name: GetMyDraftPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of draft partners associated with the current user's dashboard, including those created or modified by the user, specifically those in draft status.
example_uses: Show me my unfinished partner records.
List all partner drafts I've started.
What are the draft partners I need to complete?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to access partners that are still in draft status and are associated with the current user, allowing them to resume work on incomplete records.

endpoints.name: GetMyDraftContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of draft contacts associated with the current user's dashboard, including those created or modified by the user, specifically those in draft status.
example_uses: Show me my unfinished contact records.
List all contact drafts I've started.
What are the draft contacts I need to complete?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to access contacts that are still in draft status and are associated with the current user, allowing them to resume work on incomplete records.

endpoints.name: GetMyInteractions
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of interactions associated with the current user's dashboard, including those created or modified by the user, excluding drafts.
example_uses: Get the interactions I'm involved in.
Show me all interactions I've recently updated.
List my active interactions on the dashboard.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to quickly view interactions relevant to the current user's activities, such as those they created or recently modified, excluding any draft interactions.

endpoints.name: GetMyDraftInteractions
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of draft interactions associated with the current user's dashboard, including those created or modified by the user, specifically those in draft status.
example_uses: Show me my unfinished interaction records.
List all interaction drafts I've started.
What are the draft interactions I need to complete?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to access interactions that are still in draft status and are associated with the current user, allowing them to resume work on incomplete records.

endpoints.name: GetOrgUnitRecentUpdates
endpoints.description: Retrieves recent updates across all entity types (Partners, Contacts, Interactions) within the current user's organizational unit.
example_uses: Show me the latest activities in my department.
What's new across partners, contacts, and interactions in my unit?
Get a summary of recent changes in my organization.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a consolidated view of the most recent activities and updates across all major entity types (Partners, Contacts, Interactions) within the user's organizational unit, providing an overview of team progress.
